description: This file defines the OnDemandServer class, which manages a basic on-demand server launcher supporting a single named service port on macOS. It includes method declarations for initializing, creating, launching, and cleaning up the server, along with detailed comments and usage examples.

classes.name: OnDemandServer
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle of an on-demand server supporting a single named service port on macOS.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Creates the bootstrap server and service with specified command and service name.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate an OnDemandServer object if initialization succeeds.

methods.name: LaunchOnDemand
methods.description: Triggers the server to launch by sending a mach message to the service port.

methods.name: GetServicePort
methods.description: Returns the mach port for the service to which messages should be sent.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Cleans up and unregisters the service if not yet launched.
